'''Information Retrieval''' was a vast clearinghouse of data accessible to the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] and high government officials, such as [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]][[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]], who while analyzing a [[Blood/Legends|blood]] sample, used it to determine his [[Gender/Legends|daughters]] [[Che Amanwe Papanoida/Legends|Che Amanwe]] and [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway]] were [[Kidnapping of the Papanoida daughters/Legends|kidnapped]] by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]].<ref name="SoI" />

Information Retrieval could also be used to detect the identity of a someone covered by a [[Clothing/Legends|hood]] and in a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. This was how [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and a few [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] at [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]]  [[Royal Academy of Government/Legends|Royal Academy]] determined [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec]] was involved in a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Mandalorian black market conspiracy/Legends|conspiracy]].<ref name="The Academy" />
